name: Planting Assistance Program for Hybrid Seeds of Vegetable Crops
benefit: 1. Financial support of 40% of the cost incurred for the hybrid seed plantation, ₹50,000/- per hectare unit cost. 1. Maximum assistance of ₹20,000/- per hectare under both components: - Hybrid Seed Plantation. - Promotion of Natural Farming in Vegetable Crops.
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant must be a farmer. 1. For natural farming component, the farmer must be listed by the district ATMA office or be part of a FIG practicing natural farming.
